colorup.title: ColorUp: Creative 3D Parkour Adventure Game
colorup.slogan: Where every brushstroke is an adventure!
colorup.description: Explore a vibrant world in ColorUp, solve colorful puzzles, and be captivated by the joy of creation! This 3D parkour game challenges you to jump up 1076 meters of altitude with breathtaking jumps and alignments. Experience stunning graphics, relaxing sounds, and thrilling gameplay. Start your colorful adventure today!

HomeIframe.title: ColorUp: Creative 3D Parkour Adventure Game
HomeIframe.description: Jump into the vibrant world of ColorUp! Solve puzzles, collect outfits, and conquer colorful stairs in this thrilling 3D parkour game. Start your adventure now!

HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: ColorUp is a vibrant 3D parkour game where you control a character in a festive town, jumping up colorful stairs and collecting items to unlock mysteries.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Use the mouse to look around and adjust your direction.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Use the arrow keys to navigate your character.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Press the spacebar to jump up the stairs.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Experience vivid colors and immersive visuals in every scene.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Enjoy peaceful sounds that enhance the game's atmosphere.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Master the techniques to navigate challenging jumps and alignments.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Gather items to change your character's appearance.
